title: Currency & stuff
description: custom named resource pack that adds currency and other stuff
body:
![Currency & Stuff 1.4 banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9406410960b77daf52866ab0ce5fa8874d71be3e.png)

what this pack does: This pack adds curancy/money and many other models to minecraft you name a cookie $1 $10 $100 $200 $500 & $1000 it will change it to a form of currancy which you can eat which is kinda funny.

custom renames added by the pack.

    mace skins:
      - ban hamer
      - black hole
      - macey
      - mine
      - mkolnir
      - stormbreaker
    spear skins:
      - netherite spear
      - iron spear
      - diamond spear
      - emerald spear
      - gold spear
      - barbed netherite spear
      - barbed iron spear
      - barbed diamond spear
      - barbed emerald spear
      - barbed gold spear
      - winged netherite spear
      - winged iron spear
      - winged diamond spear
      - winged emerald spear
      - winged gold spear
    sword skins:
      - netherite katana
      - iron katana
      - diamond katana
      - emerald katana
      - gold katana
      - netherite great sword
      - iron great sword
      - diamond great sword
      - emerald great sword
      - gold great sword
      - energy sword
    axe skins:
      - stormbreaker
    new hat have been added all renamed from a carved pumken.
    the hats are:
      - beanie
      - grad hat
      - cowboy hat
      - halo
      - chef hat
      - headset
      - pirate hat
      - cap
      - crown
    stick skins:
      - umbrella
    gold ingot skins:
       - trophy


       ![all the items in the pack. used resource pack al's armor stands and whimscape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/068abb1b831ff1320e3b1c73314d6dc815830d7b.png)

how you are able to use this pack:
- if you use this in any form of content there must be a link refering back to the download page
- do not redistribute
- you can use it in modpacks without asking but refer to this page in the discription of the modpack
- ask me to use it if you want to intergate it into a mod
- you can use this pack to create your own resource pack but only to learn how to make a pack like this one and to build your structure for the pack but i sugest to use Infamous Jam's template resource pack 
  the download link to it is here:
  
  https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/custom-texture-name-dependent-example/
  
  and the tutorial link is here:
  
  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cCOple2U8Q&t=18s
